Fig. 2. Overall pipeline of MPTF-Net. The network jointly exploits RIV and BEV representations containing geometric and intensity cues. RIV and BEV branches adopt ResNet-based backbones, and the multi-scale Transformer fusion module captures cross-view interactions. Finally, the context-gating enhanced NetVLAD aggregates the fused features into discriminative, viewpoint-invariant global descriptors.

Fig. 3. Block diagram of the BEV multi-feature encoding structure. After dividing the polar coordinate grids and selecting the point cloud clusters within the grids, NDT methods are utilized to compute geometric and intensity statistics.
